#!/bin/sh
set -eu
umask 077

BASE="${OLLAMA_KEEPALIVE_BASE:-/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp}"
LAUNCHER="$BASE/run-ollama.sh"
OLLAMA_BIN="$BASE/miniconda/bin/ollama"
PIDFILE="$BASE/ollama-runtime.pid"
RUNTIME_LOG="$BASE/ollama-runtime.log"
STATE="$BASE/.ollama-keepalive"
LOCK="$STATE/ensure-v2.lock"
LOG="$STATE/keepalive.log"
URL="http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version"

mkdir -p "$STATE"
chmod 700 "$STATE"

ts() { date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'; }
log() {
  printf '%s %s\n' "$(ts)" "$*" >>"$LOG"
  chmod 600 "$LOG" 2>/dev/null || :
}
healthy() { curl -fsS --max-time 3 "$URL" >/dev/null 2>&1; }
pid_value() {
  [ -s "$PIDFILE" ] || return 1
  tr -dc '0-9' <"$PIDFILE"
}
ours_pid() {
  pid="$1"
  [ -n "$pid" ] && [ -r "/proc/$pid/cmdline" ] || return 1
  tr '\000' ' ' <"/proc/$pid/cmdline" | grep -F "$OLLAMA_BIN serve" >/dev/null 2>&1
}
start_runtime() {
  [ -x "$LAUNCHER" ] || { log "start_failed launcher_missing"; return 2; }
  [ -x "$OLLAMA_BIN" ] || { log "start_failed binary_missing"; return 3; }

  if healthy; then
    log "ensure_pass already_healthy"
    return 0
  fi

  pid="$(pid_value 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if [ -n "$pid" ] && ours_pid "$pid"; then
    log "ensure_degraded owned_pid_unhealthy pid=$pid"
    return 4
  fi
  [ -z "$pid" ] || log "discard_stale_pid pid=$pid"
  rm -f "$PIDFILE"

  log "start_begin"
  if command -v setsid >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    nohup setsid "$LAUNCHER" >>"$RUNTIME_LOG" 2>&1 </dev/null 9>&- &
  else
    nohup "$LAUNCHER" >>"$RUNTIME_LOG" 2>&1 </dev/null 9>&- &
  fi
  pid=$!
  printf '%s\n' "$pid" >"$PIDFILE"
  chmod 600 "$PIDFILE"

  i=0
  while [ "$i" -lt 20 ]; do
    if healthy; then
      log "start_pass pid=$pid"
      return 0
    fi
    [ -r "/proc/$pid/cmdline" ] || break
    sleep 1
    i=$((i+1))
  done
  log "start_failed pid=$pid"
  return 5
}
with_lock() {
  command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
    echo "flock unavailable" >&2
    return 2
  }
  exec 9>"$LOCK"
  flock -n 9 || return 75
  "$@"
}
cmd_ensure() { start_runtime; }
cmd_status() {
  if healthy; then
    echo "OLLAMA_KEEPALIVE=HEALTHY pid=$(pid_value 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
    return 0
  fi
  echo "OLLAMA_KEEPALIVE=DEGRADED pid=$(pid_value 2>/dev/null || echo none)"
  return 1
}

case "${1:-ensure}" in
  ensure) with_lock cmd_ensure ;;
  status) with_lock cmd_status ;;
  *) echo "usage: $0 [ensure|status]" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
